lines: Kelly’s family visits the Malaysian rainforest.
Kelly stops in front of a white and pink flower.
The guide says, “Oh, that is an insect, not a flower.
A butterfly sits on the mantis.
The mantis catches the butterfly and eats it.
The guide laughs and says, “The butterfly thought the mantis was a flower.”
He also says, “Orchid mantises eat flying insects and fruit.
Sometimes, hungry females eat the males.”
“Oh no! Mom!” Kelly runs to her parents.
body.text: Kelly’s family visits the Malaysian rainforest. A guide goes with them. Kelly stops in front of a white and pink flower. “Hey! The flower moves!” shouts Kelly. The guide says, “Oh, that is an insect, not a flower. It’s an orchid mantis.” A butterfly sits on the mantis. The mantis catches the butterfly and eats it. “Eek!” Kelly is surprised. The guide laughs and says, “The butterfly thought the mantis was a flower.” He also says, “Orchid mantises eat flying insects and fruit. Sometimes, hungry females eat the males.” “Oh no! Mom!” Kelly runs to her parents.
